suite_status.scope: Completed means all suite commands and independent audits passed; it does not certify speed or answer preservation.

cross_mode_controls.scope: Within this machine only. Timings across modes are not equal computational work; across-hardware continuation identity remains unchecked.

interpretation.speed_ratio: Baseline full-session time divided by adaptive time. Above 1 favors adaptive; includes original prefill and canceled work.
interpretation.memory: Serialized paused-state bytes are host-cache storage, distinct from CUDA allocation/reservation. RSS sampling can miss short peaks.
interpretation.quality: Free-generation scores are exact answers on generated lookup, two-hop and arithmetic tasks. Repeats and contexts are not new independent questions. Equal-work results do not score answers.
interpretation.components: Component means overlap: pause includes planning/export/encode; resume includes restore/recompute/generation. Do not add component columns together.
interpretation.statistics: Descriptive run and per-repeat ratios; no significance or confidence interval is claimed.
interpretation.cross_mode_decisions: Each mode calibrates costs independently. The policy algorithm and workload controls match, but equal-work and free-generation modes can choose different cache actions; quality evidence is specific to the free-generation actions actually exercised.
interpretation.historical_comparison: Only model-manifest file hashes are compared with historical P100 records. No old-protocol speed or quality results are pooled.
interpretation.scope: Sequential reference runner, CPU codecs after native export; not serving throughput, capacity, dollar savings or a pure GPU-only causal comparison.
